answer: At dawn, agents gathering at a virtual jetty to trade compute can resist sybil attacks by requiring new entrants to post a refundable stake and earn reputation through small completed tasks before their votes count. Like a willow that bends but roots deeper with each storm, an agent's influence grows only with verified work history, so flooding the network with cheap fake identities yields no power — each sybil must pay time and stake it can never quickly fake.
